newsitem.title: USA: TECO sets gas distribution expansion.
newsitem.headline: TECO sets gas distribution expansion.

text.p: TECO Energy Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire West Florida Gas Inc in a tax-free, stock-for-stock transaction valued at $21 million.

TECO said the number of shares to be issued for West Florida Gas will depend on the average market price during a specified period prior to the closing. Based on Tuesday's closing price of $25.38, the number of shares would be approximately 800,000.
West Florida Gas Inc. is the privately-owned holding company of West Florida Natural Gas Co, a local distribution company (LDC) based in Panama City.
Earlier this week, TECO Energy completed its acquisition of Lykes Energy's Peoples Gas family of businesses in a stock transaction having a market value of $300 million.

TECO chief executive Timothy Guzzle said annual customer growth in recent years has ranged between two percent and four percent throughout West Florida's service territory. "Our plan is to merge that business into Peoples Gas System."
